subject: Agriculture
question: <image 1> What is your opinion on the fact that certain large insects act as predators of pests? Are they allies or enemies in your view?

options.A: Neutral; it doesn't affect the crops positively or negatively.
options.B: Symbiotic; it has a mutual relationship with the crops.
options.C: Vector; it is not a pest directly but spreads viruses which damage yield.
options.D: Threat; it may not harm the crops directly, but its presence could attract other pests.
options.E: Beneficial; it helps in biological control of pests.
options.F: Neither; this large insect is not a problem, nor is it a beneficial.
options.G: I don't know and don't want to guess.
options.H: Friend; this is clearly a predator of pests.
options.I: Foe; this is a pest of crops.
options.J: Parasitic; it feeds on the pests but also harms the crops.
